outOfScope: Changing product WHAT or acceptance semantics to make an efficiency candidate pass.
Replacing Application domain authority, Oracle source ownership, Jev/QA judgment authority or EffectOperation truth.
Adopting Unreal Agent wholesale or treating its benchmark as ExHarness acceptance evidence.
constraints: Canonical operation/effect state must not be inferred from prompt text.
Earlier committed prompt content must not be rewritten solely to update a running operation.
Provider-specific multiple-result behavior must be capability-checked; unsupported semantics require an explicit compatible encoding or synchronous fallback.
Cache metrics are observational optimization evidence, never correctness authority.
invariants: Async scheduling and prompt optimization cannot become correctness, product-acceptance or external-effect authority.
Every detached operation remains bound to exact call/turn/action/effect identity and unresolved effect ambiguity fails closed.
Efficiency claims require matched evidence with fixed model, task semantics, tool surface and resource budget.
architectureDecisions: Borrow Unreal Agent's committed-prefix/staged-suffix idea as a pattern, not its provider-specific wire representation.
Represent canonical async state in Core events/operation records and render model-visible progress from those records.
Make provider compatibility explicit at the model-adapter boundary and keep synchronous fallback measurable.
implementationSlices: Research current synchronous Core and pinned public references; isolate the smallest reusable mechanism and measurable gap.
Define exact durable contracts, provider/runtime boundaries, negative cases and compatibility fallback before implementation.
Implement or retain baseline only after a matched probe can distinguish quality, cost/token, turn, cache and recovery outcomes.

Probe at least one OpenAI-compatible and one non-identical provider path for progressive tool-result compatibility.

negativeVerificationCases: A detached operation causes a duplicate non-idempotent external effect after restart or concurrent wakeup.
A token/cost win is accepted despite degraded fixed quality or missing failed-attempt accounting.
Prompt text, traces or provider cache state are used as external-effect or product-acceptance authority.
